title: Module flatness over an etale base local ring
statement: Let $e:T\to S$ be an etale morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-etale-morphism]. Let $t\in T$, put $s=e(t)$, and let $M$ be an $\mathcal O_{T,t}$-module. Regard $M$ as an $\mathcal O_{S,s}$-module through the stalk map $e_t^\sharp:\mathcal O_{S,s}\to\mathcal O_{T,t}$; stalks and scalar actions are as in [def-pc-module-stalk-functor]. Then $M$ is flat over $\mathcal O_{S,s}$ if and only if it is flat over $\mathcal O_{T,t}$, where module flatness is as in [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. No finiteness assumption on $M$ is imposed.

source.place: Tag 05BA, lemma-etale-flat-up-down-local-ring; proof via Tag 05B9, lemma-etale-flat-up-down.

proof.text: Put R = O_{S,e(t)} and A = O_{T,t}. Give A the R-algebra structure of the stalk map, and M the restricted R-module structure in the statement. IsScalarTower.of_compHom supplies compatibility. Since A is a ring, Module.addCommMonoidToAddCommGroup A supplies additive inverses on M without changing its given additive monoid or module structure. The etale hypothesis [def-weil-etale-morphism] gives LocallyOfFiniteType e and FormallyUnramified e. Apply Mathlib LocallyOfFiniteType.stalkMap and FormallyUnramified.stalkMap, and translate the ring-hom properties to Algebra.EssFiniteType R A and Algebra.FormallyUnramified R A using RingHom.essFiniteType_algebraMap and RingHom.formallyUnramified_algebraMap.

If M is flat over R, apply [lem-sc-unramified-flat-of-base-flat], namely Algebra.FormallyUnramified.flat_of_restrictScalars R A M, with the essentially finite type and formally unramified algebra instances from Step 1. This proves A-flatness of the given arbitrary module M; the Mathlib result permits independent universes for the rings and module.

Conversely, the etale hypothesis [def-weil-etale-morphism] implies e is flat [def-weil-flat-morphism]. Mathlib Flat.stalkMap e t and RingHom.flat_algebraMap_iff give Module.Flat R A. If M is flat over A, apply [lem-pc-module-flat-transitive], namely Module.Flat.trans R A M. The resulting R-action is precisely Module.compHom M (e.stalkMap t).hom. The two implications give the required equivalence without finiteness assumptions on M.

proof_origin.place: Algebra.FormallyUnramified.flat_of_restrictScalars (Iversen I.2.7), combined with Mathlib LocallyOfFiniteType.stalkMap, FormallyUnramified.stalkMap, Flat.stalkMap, and Module.Flat.trans. This algebraic proof specializes directly to the stalk-module equivalence of Stacks Tag 05BA (lemma-etale-flat-up-down-local-ring).
